track.title: Track
track.intro: Arrange kept beats, chords and loops on four lanes of bars, edit them, mix them and export a WAV. Letters are commands here, not notes.

tab_track.title: TRACK TAB
tab_track.summary: Arrange beats, chords and loops into a piece.
tab_track.does: Opens the Track page: keep what you made as clips, place them on four lanes of bars, edit and export to a WAV file.

use.text: Tap the tab; the page you are on is inverted.
Tab steps to the next page in this order.

tab_track.recall: Tab strip along the top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward; Esc returns to Synth.
tab_track.ask: What can I do on the Track page?

tab_synth.title: SYNTH TAB
tab_synth.summary: The instrument: scope, strings, chords, loop.
tab_synth.does: Goes to the Synth page where you play. Esc does the same from anywhere.

use.text: Tap the tab; the page you are on is inverted.
Tab steps to the next page in this order.

tab_synth.recall: Tab strip along the top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward; Esc returns to Synth.
tab_synth.ask: What can I do on the Synth page?

tab_sound.title: SOUND TAB
tab_sound.summary: Pick and shape the current sound.
tab_sound.does: Goes to the Sound page: ten slots, quick sliders, All parameters, favourites, Store and Save.

use.text: Tap the tab; the page you are on is inverted.
Tab steps to the next page in this order.

tab_sound.recall: Tab strip along the top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward; Esc returns to Synth.
tab_sound.ask: What can I do on the Sound page?

tab_beat.title: BEAT TAB
tab_beat.summary: Drum machine: pads, kits, kept beats.
tab_beat.does: Goes to the Beat page: eight pads, one bar of 16 steps, three kits and a row of kept beats.

use.text: Tap the tab; the page you are on is inverted.
Tab steps to the next page in this order.

tab_beat.recall: Tab strip along the top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward; Esc returns to Synth.
tab_beat.ask: What can I do on the Beat page?

tab_backing.title: BACKING TAB
tab_backing.summary: Backing chords and how they play.
tab_backing.does: Goes to the Backing page: chord mode, style, progression, chord length and volume.

use.text: Tap the tab; the page you are on is inverted.
Tab steps to the next page in this order.

tab_backing.recall: Tab strip along the top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward; Esc returns to Synth.
tab_backing.ask: What can I do on the Backing page?

tab_tune.title: TUNE TAB
tab_tune.does: Goes to the Tune page: choose the key and scale that lock your notes, set tempo and slide speed.

use.text: Tap the tab; the page you are on is inverted.
Tab steps to the next page in this order.

tab_tune.recall: Tab strip along the top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward; Esc returns to Synth.
tab_tune.ask: What can I do on the Tune page?

tab_system.title: SYSTEM TAB
tab_system.does: Goes to the System page: master volume, touch pad mapping, record, save session, key test, Panic, Quit.

use.text: Tap the tab; the page you are on is inverted.
Tab steps to the next page in this order.

tab_system.recall: Tab strip along the top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward; Esc returns to Synth.
tab_system.ask: What can I do on the System page?

tab_help.title: HELP TAB
tab_help.does: Goes to the Help page: four pages of default keys for playing, commands, the beat and the Track. Ctrl+H toggles it.

use.text: Tap the tab; the page you are on is inverted.
Tab steps to the next page in this order.

tab_help.recall: Tab strip along the top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward; Esc returns to Synth.
tab_help.ask: What can I do on the Help page?

tab_chat.title: CHAT TAB
tab_chat.does: Goes to the Chat page. Shows a count like Chat 2 when copilot messages are unread. Ctrl+Y jumps there and back.

use.text: Tap the tab; the page you are on is inverted.
Tab steps to the next page in this order.

tab_chat.recall: Tab strip along the top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward; Esc returns to Synth.
tab_chat.ask: What can I do on the Chat page?

shelf_clip0.title: CLIP SHELF
shelf_clip0.summary: Your kept clips. Tap one to pick it up.
shelf_clip0.does: A clip is a copy of a beat, a chord progression or a loop you made. The shelf shows five at a time, with name and length. Tap one to take it in hand (inverted), then tap a bar in its lane or Place. Tap it again to put it down.

use.text: Tap a clip, then a bar in its lane.
Press 1 to 5 to take the shelf clip with that number.

shelf_clip0.recall: Track page, left column. + Keep adds clips; Remove with a clip in hand deletes it and its copies (asks twice).
tips: Keeping again after changing the beat makes a new clip: Beat 2.
shelf_clip0.ask: What is a clip, and how is it different from the beat?

track_keep.title: + KEEP
track_keep.summary: Copies the live beat, chords and loop onto the shelf.
track_keep.does: Copies what exists now (the beat, the backing chords and the loop) onto the shelf as clips: Beat 1, Chords 1, Loop 1. Anything already kept is skipped. The last one added goes in your hand. Originals are untouched.

use.text: Tap + Keep after making something.
K.

track_keep.recall: Track page, bottom of the shelf. K on this page. Up to 40 clips; Remove deletes one.
tips: Nothing to keep? Make a beat, tap chords or record a loop first.
track_keep.ask: Why does + Keep say there is nothing to keep?

track_shelf_page.title: SHELF PAGE
track_shelf_page.summary: Shows the next five clips on the shelf.
track_shelf_page.does: Appears when you have more than five clips. Shows the page and total like 1/2; each tap goes on and wraps round to the first page.

use.text: Tap to step through shelf pages.

track_shelf_page.recall: Track page, beside + Keep, once there are over five clips.
tips: Clips are numbered 1 to 5 on every page; keys 1 to 5 pick from the shown page.

track_ruler.title: BAR RULER / PLAY LINE
track_ruler.summary: The numbered bars above the lanes. Tap to set the play line.
track_ruler.does: Tap or drag on a bar number to put the play line there. If the track is playing it jumps to that bar. The bar numbers inverted show the cycle range. Place, Split and Play start from the line.

use.text: Tap or drag along the numbers.
Shift+Left / Right, or , and ., move the line a bar.

track_ruler.recall: Track page, strip above the lanes. Enter sends the line back to bar 1.
tips: Eight bars show at once; Shown - / + scrolls by four.
track_ruler.ask: How do I start playing from a later bar?

track_lanes.title: LANES
track_lanes.summary: Four lanes of bars: Beat, Chords, Loop A, Loop B.
track_lanes.does: Beats go on Beat, chord clips on Chords, loops on Loop A or B (so two loops can play at once). Tap a clip to choose it (double frame); drag it to move it, even between loop lanes. With a clip in hand, tap an empty bar to place it.

use.text: Tap to choose or place; drag a chosen clip to move it.
Arrows choose; Alt+arrows move a bar or lane; Ctrl+V pastes.

track_lanes.recall: Track page, the grid in the middle. Clips snap to whole bars. Ctrl+Z undoes a move.
tips: A clip will not go where bars are taken or the lane is the wrong kind.
track_lanes.ask: Why will my clip not go where I drop it?

track_place.title: PLACE
track_place.summary: Puts the clip in your hand at the play line.
track_place.does: Places the clip you picked up on its lane at the play line, then moves the line on, so tapping Place four times lays four in a row. A dashed box shows where it will go; the button says at bar N or no room.

use.text: Pick a clip on the shelf, then tap Place.
Ctrl+V pastes the clip in hand at the line.

track_place.recall: Track page, tools row, first button. Esc puts the clip down. Ctrl+Z undoes a placement.
track_place.ask: How do I lay clips down one after another?

track_chop.title: CHOP
track_chop.summary: Cuts the chosen clip into pieces you can reorder.
track_chop.does: Opens the Chop panel for the chosen clip: cut it at the beat lines, then move, mute or repeat the pieces so it plays in a new order. Only that placed copy changes, and it stays in time and the same length.

use.text: Choose a placed clip, then tap Chop.
E; E again or Esc closes it.

track_chop.recall: Track page, tools row. Reset in the Chop panel undoes every cut. Ctrl+Z also undoes.
tips: Chopping never changes the clip on the shelf.

track_sound.title: SOUND
track_sound.summary: Gives a placed clip another instrument.
track_sound.does: Opens the sound picker for the chosen clip: Keys, Guitar, Bass, your own sounds, or another drum kit for a beat. What you recorded is untouched; As recorded brings it back. The line under shows what it plays now.

use.text: Choose a placed clip, then tap Sound.
I; I, Enter or Esc closes it.

track_sound.recall: Track page, tools row. As recorded (in the picker) puts the original sound back.
tips: The Hear button plays the clip alone so you can audition.
track_sound.ask: How do I make a loop sound like a guitar or bass?

track_repeat.title: REPEAT
track_repeat.summary: Puts a copy right after the chosen clip.
track_repeat.does: Adds another copy of the chosen clip on the same lane, in the bars straight after it. If the bars are taken it says no room.

use.text: Choose a clip, tap Repeat.
Ctrl+R.

track_repeat.recall: Track page, tools row. Ctrl+R on this page (it is New sound elsewhere). Ctrl+Z undoes it.
tips: Repeat several times to fill a lane quickly.
track_repeat.ask: How do I repeat a clip a few times?

track_remove.title: REMOVE
track_remove.summary: Takes the chosen clip off the track.
track_remove.does: Removes the chosen placed clip. With a shelf clip in hand and nothing chosen it deletes the clip and every copy of it, and asks twice (the button says again to delete). Undo brings placed clips back.

use.text: Choose a clip, tap Remove.
Backspace deletes the chosen clip.

track_remove.recall: Track page, tools row, last button. Ctrl+Z undoes removing a placed clip; deleting from the shelf is final.
tips: With nothing chosen, Backspace on this page is still Panic.
track_remove.ask: How do I delete a clip from the shelf?

track_play.title: PLAY / STOP TRACK
track_play.summary: Plays the track from the play line.
track_play.does: Plays round and round from the play line (or the cycle). The live beat, backing and loop are stopped, but you can still play the strings over it. The button shows the bar number while playing.

use.text: Tap Play or Stop.
Space here; Ctrl+Space from any page.

track_play.recall: Track page, bottom left of the tools; Ctrl+Space anywhere. Enter sends the line to bar 1.
tips: Go to the Synth page while it plays to record a loop in time with it.
track_play.ask: Can I play along while the track plays?

track_cycle.title: CYCLE
track_cycle.does: Turns on a loop region: the chosen clip's bars, or four bars from the play line if none is chosen. The cycled bars show inverted in the ruler. Play goes round inside it. Tap again to turn it off. Export ignores it.

use.text: Choose a clip (optional), tap Cycle.
C.

track_cycle.recall: Track page, beside Play. C on this page. Tap again to switch off.
track_cycle.ask: How do I loop one part while I work on it?

track_length-.title: LENGTH
track_length-.summary: How many bars the track has.
track_length-.does: Sets the track length, 1 to 64 bars. It grows by itself when you place past the end. Shrinking is blocked while a clip sits in the bars to be cut off.

use.text: Tap − or +.

track_length-.recall: Track page, beside Cycle. A message says if a clip is in the way.
track_length-.ask: How long can a track be?

track_export.title: EXPORT
track_export.summary: Writes the whole track to a WAV audio file.
track_export.does: Plays the track once, bar 1 to the end, at full master volume with the lane mix, ignoring the cycle, and keeps going until the echoes die. Done in the background much faster than real time. The button shows percent.

use.text: Tap Export; wait for the message.
Ctrl+B on this page.

track_export.recall: Track page, tools row. File goes to ~/vrequency/recordings/track-....wav. System > Play last plays it.
tips: Ctrl+B means Backing mode on other pages.
track_export.ask: Where does my exported track go?

track_split.title: SPLIT
track_split.summary: Cuts the chosen clip in two at the play line.
track_split.does: Splits the chosen clip where the play line stands. The line must be inside the clip on a bar line. Each half can then be moved, muted, removed or given its own sound.

use.text: Choose a clip, set the line on a bar, tap Split.
Ctrl+T.

track_split.recall: Track page, second row, first button. Ctrl+T (it is Tap tempo elsewhere). Join mends it.
track_split.ask: How do I cut a clip at a certain bar?

track_join.title: JOIN
track_join.summary: Joins the chosen clip with the one after it.
track_join.does: Mends two clips back into one, but only if the next one carries on from it: a repeat, or the other half of a split. Otherwise it explains that it only joins what continues.

use.text: Choose the first clip, tap Join.
Ctrl+J.

track_join.recall: Track page, second row. Ctrl+J (it is Beat play elsewhere).
track_join.ask: Why will Join not work on my two clips?

track_mute.title: MUTE CLIP
track_mute.summary: Silences the chosen clip without removing it.
track_mute.does: Turns the chosen placed clip off: it stays on the track, drawn hatched, but is not heard. Tap again to bring it back.

use.text: Choose a clip, tap Mute.
M.

track_mute.recall: Track page, second row. M on this page. To mute a whole lane, use the Mix panel.
track_mute.ask: How do I mute one clip but keep it?

track_undo.title: UNDO
track_undo.summary: Takes back the last track edit.
track_undo.does: Steps back through track edits, up to 40: placing, moving, splitting, chopping, picked sounds, mixer changes. A whole drag or fader move is one step. The button shows how many steps exist.

use.text: Tap Undo, repeat for more steps.
Ctrl+Z; Shift+Ctrl+Z redoes.

track_undo.recall: Track page, second row. Ctrl+Z, and Shift+Ctrl+Z for redo. Only the Track; sounds have their own undo.
track_undo.ask: How do I undo a move on the track?

track_mixer.title: MIX
track_mixer.does: Swaps the tools for a mixer: a fader, meter, mute and solo for each lane. The button says lanes changed if any differ from the default. Levels are saved with the track and heard in an export.

use.text: Tap Mix.
X; X, Esc or Enter closes it.

track_mixer.recall: Track page, second row, fifth button. X on this page.
track_mixer.ask: How do I set the balance between the lanes?

track_view-.title: SHOWN (BARS ON SCREEN)
track_view-.summary: Scrolls which eight bars are visible.
track_view-.does: The lanes show eight bars at a time. − and + shift the window back or on by four bars. It also follows the play line while the track plays.

use.text: Tap − or +.

track_view-.recall: Track page, bottom right of the tools. Shown reads like 1-8.
track_view-.ask: How do I see later bars?

track.recall: Track tab. Ctrl+Space plays or stops the track from any page.

track-chop.title: Track: Chop
track-chop.intro: Cut one placed clip into pieces, then move, mute or repeat them. The clip stays in time and the same length.

tab_track.title: PAGE TABS
tab_track.summary: The strip of nine tabs along the top.
tab_track.does: Track, Synth, Sound, Beat, Backing, Tune, System, Help and Chat. The page you are on is inverted. Chat shows how many copilot messages are unread. The Synth page has no strip: Menu or any tab brings you here.

use.text: Tap a tab to go there.
Tab steps to the next page; Esc goes to Synth.

tab_track.recall: Top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward through all nine; Esc returns to Synth.
tips: Ctrl+H toggles Help and Ctrl+Y toggles Chat from anywhere.
tab_track.ask: What is on each of the pages?

chop_strip.title: CHOP STRIP
chop_strip.summary: One pass of the clip. Tap a dotted line to cut there.
chop_strip.does: Shows the clip as lettered pieces A, B, C... Dotted lines are the places a cut may fall. Tap near one to cut; tap an existing cut to mend it. Tap anywhere inside a piece to choose it (inverted header). Muted pieces are hatched.

use.text: Tap a dotted line to cut or mend; tap a piece to choose it.
Left / Right choose a piece; Ctrl+T cuts it in half, Ctrl+J mends.

chop_strip.recall: Track page: choose a placed clip, then Chop (E). Reset undoes every cut.
tips: Pieces always stay in time; the clip keeps its length.
chop_strip.ask: How do I cut a clip into pieces?

chop_halves.title: HALVES
chop_halves.summary: Cuts the clip in two, down the middle.
chop_halves.does: Makes one cut at the halfway point of the clip's pass.

use.text: Tap Halves.

chop_halves.recall: Chop panel, first button. Reset undoes it.

chop_beats.title: BEATS / BARS
chop_beats.summary: Cuts at every beat (or bar for long clips).
chop_beats.does: Makes a cut at every grid line at once. The grid is finer for short clips: every beat up to 4 bars, every 2 beats up to 8 bars, then every bar; the label says Beats or Bars and the line under says which.

use.text: Tap to cut the whole strip evenly.

chop_beats.recall: Chop panel, second button. Reset undoes every cut.
tips: Use it first, then mute or move the pieces you want to change.
chop_beats.ask: How do I cut a clip into equal pieces?

chop_reset.title: RESET
chop_reset.summary: Undoes every cut in this placed clip.
chop_reset.does: Puts the clip back into one whole piece in its original order, and unmutes any muted pieces. Only this placed copy is affected.

use.text: Tap Reset.

chop_reset.recall: Chop panel, third button. Ctrl+Z also steps back.
chop_reset.ask: How do I start the chopping over?

chop_done.title: DONE
chop_done.does: Returns to the track tools. Your chops stay on that placed clip. E or Esc does the same.

use.text: Tap Done.
E or Esc.

chop_done.recall: Chop panel, last button of the first row.
chop_done.ask: How do I leave the Chop panel?

chop_move_left.title: ‹ MOVE
chop_move_left.does: Swaps the chosen piece with the one before it, so the clip plays in a new order. The line under names the piece (for example piece B earlier). The clip keeps its length.

use.text: Choose a piece, tap ‹ Move.
Alt+Left.

chop_move_left.recall: Chop panel, bottom row. Pieces may only swap with a neighbour.

chop_move_right.title: MOVE ›
chop_move_right.does: Swaps the chosen piece with the one after it. The line under names the piece. Repeat to carry a piece to the end.

use.text: Choose a piece, tap Move ›.
Alt+Right.

chop_move_right.ask: How do I send a piece to the end?

chop_mute_piece.title: MUTE PIECE
chop_mute_piece.summary: Leaves a gap where the chosen piece was.
chop_mute_piece.does: Silences just that piece, hatched in the strip; the other pieces keep playing in time. Tap again to bring it back.

use.text: Choose a piece, tap Mute piece.
M.

chop_mute_piece.recall: Chop panel, bottom row. Reset un-mutes every piece.
chop_mute_piece.ask: How do I drop out part of a loop?

chop_repeat_piece.title: REPEAT PIECE
chop_repeat_piece.summary: Makes the next piece play this one again.
chop_repeat_piece.does: Makes the next piece play the same material as the chosen one (including a mute), so the same bit plays twice in a row. The clip keeps its length; what the next piece held is no longer played.

use.text: Choose a piece, tap Repeat piece.
Ctrl+R.

chop_repeat_piece.recall: Chop panel, bottom row. Reset puts everything back.
tips: Chop a loop into beats, then repeat one hit for a stutter.
chop_repeat_piece.ask: How do I make a stutter effect?

track-chop.recall: Track page: choose a clip, then Chop (or E). Done or Esc comes back.

tips: A clip will not go where bars are taken or the lane is the wrong kind.
track_lanes.ask: Why will my clip not go where I drop it?

sound_kind0.title: KEYS KIND
sound_kind0.does: Six keyboard-style sounds: E-piano, Soft keys, Organ, Toy keys, Clav and Strings. Shaped from the synth voice to suggest each instrument; they are not recordings.

use.text: Tap to show its sounds in the six cells.
Left / Right step the kind.

sound_kind0.recall: Track page: choose a placed clip, tap Sound (or I). Done or I closes it.
sound_kind0.ask: What are the keys sounds like?

sound_kind1.title: SYNTH KIND
sound_kind1.does: Your own sounds: the ten slots, then your favourites. Turn the page with the sixth cell when there are more than six. A pick copies the sound, so later edits to the slot do not change the clip.

use.text: Tap to show its sounds in the six cells.
Left / Right step the kind.

sound_kind1.recall: Track page: choose a placed clip, tap Sound (or I). Done or I closes it.
sound_kind1.ask: What are the synth sounds like?

sound_kind2.title: GUITAR KIND
sound_kind2.does: Six guitar-like sounds: Pluck, Steel, Clean, Drive, Mute and Twelve. A synth's imitation of a guitar, not a string model.

use.text: Tap to show its sounds in the six cells.
Left / Right step the kind.

sound_kind2.recall: Track page: choose a placed clip, tap Sound (or I). Done or I closes it.
sound_kind2.ask: What are the guitar sounds like?

sound_kind3.title: BASS KIND
sound_kind3.does: Six bass sounds: Sub, Round, Pick, Acid, Growl and Hollow. Picking one drops the clip an octave.

use.text: Tap to show its sounds in the six cells.
Left / Right step the kind.

sound_kind3.recall: Track page: choose a placed clip, tap Sound (or I). Done or I closes it.
sound_kind3.ask: What are the bass sounds like?

sound_kind4.title: DRUMS KIND
sound_kind4.does: For beat clips only: the three drum kits Soft, Crunchy and Glitchy. Beat clips can use only this kind; other kinds are greyed out.

use.text: Tap to show its sounds in the six cells.
Left / Right step the kind.

sound_kind4.recall: Track page: choose a placed clip, tap Sound (or I). Done or I closes it.
tips: Notes-only kinds are greyed for a beat clip, and Drums for the rest.
sound_kind4.ask: What are the drums sounds like?

sound_cell0.title: SOUND CELLS
sound_cell0.summary: The sounds of the chosen kind. Tap one to use it.
sound_cell0.does: Six cells hold the sounds of that kind. With more than six (Synth plus favourites) the sixth turns the page. Tapping a cell makes the clip play in that sound; if nothing plays, the clip starts going round so you hear it.

use.text: Tap a cell.
Press 1 to 6.

sound_cell0.recall: Sound picker, middle block. As recorded (button) puts the original back; Ctrl+Z undoes a pick.
tips: The cell with the clip's current sound is inverted.
sound_cell0.ask: How do I pick a new sound for a clip?

sound_hear.title: HEAR
sound_hear.summary: Plays the chosen clip alone, going round.
sound_hear.does: Plays only the chosen clip in a loop; everything else is silent meanwhile, whatever the mixer says. Starts by itself when you pick a sound while nothing plays. Closing the picker stops it.

use.text: Tap Hear, tap again to stop.
Space.

sound_hear.recall: Sound picker, bottom left. Not the same as solo: the rest of the track is simply off.
sound_hear.ask: How do I hear just this clip?

sound_octave-.title: OCTAVE
sound_octave-.summary: Moves the clip's notes up or down.
sound_octave-.does: Shifts the clip's notes by octaves, -2 to +2. Works with the recorded sound too. Not for beat clips (no notes). Bass picks start an octave down.

use.text: Tap − or +.
Down / Up.

sound_octave-.recall: Sound picker, bottom row. As recorded puts it back to the original octave.
sound_octave-.ask: How do I move a loop down an octave?

sound_scope.title: EVERY / ONLY THIS ONE
sound_scope.summary: Who gets the sound: every copy, or just this one.
sound_scope.does: Every <clip>: every placed copy of this clip and the shelf clip take the sound. Only this one: just the chosen copy. The chosen copy keeps its sound either way. Tap to switch.

use.text: Tap to switch between the two.

sound_scope.recall: Sound picker, bottom row, middle. The line under says which tap comes next.
tips: Set Only this one before picking if two copies need different sounds.
sound_scope.ask: How do I give only one copy a different sound?

sound_as_recorded.title: AS RECORDED
sound_as_recorded.summary: Back to the clip's original sound.
sound_as_recorded.does: Undoes any picked sound, kit and octave for the chosen copy (or every copy, per the switch), returning to what was kept. The line under names the recorded sound.

use.text: Tap As recorded.
Backspace.

sound_as_recorded.recall: Sound picker, bottom row. Ctrl+Z also undoes a pick.
sound_as_recorded.ask: How do I get the original sound back?

sound_done.title: DONE
sound_done.does: Returns to the track tools and stops Hear. The picked sound stays on the clip, and its name shows beside the clip's name on the lane.

use.text: Tap Done.
Enter, Esc or I.

sound_done.ask: How do I close the sound picker?

track-sound.recall: Track page: choose a clip, then Sound (or I). Done or Enter comes back.

track-mixer.title: Track: Mixer
track-mixer.intro: A level fader, meter, mute and solo for each of the four lanes. Saved with the track and heard in an export.

tab_track.title: PAGE TABS
tab_track.summary: The strip of nine tabs along the top.
tab_track.does: Track, Synth, Sound, Beat, Backing, Tune, System, Help and Chat. The page you are on is inverted. Chat shows how many copilot messages are unread. The Synth page has no strip: Menu or any tab brings you here.

use.text: Tap a tab to go there.
Tab steps to the next page; Esc goes to Synth.

tab_track.recall: Top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward through all nine; Esc returns to Synth.
tips: Ctrl+H toggles Help and Ctrl+Y toggles Chat from anywhere.
tab_track.ask: What is on each of the pages?

shelf_clip0.title: CLIP SHELF
shelf_clip0.summary: Your kept clips. Tap one to pick it up.
shelf_clip0.does: A clip is a copy of a beat, a chord progression or a loop you made. The shelf shows five at a time, with name and length. Tap one to take it in hand (inverted), then tap a bar in its lane or Place. Tap it again to put it down.

use.text: Tap a clip, then a bar in its lane.
Press 1 to 5 to take the shelf clip with that number.

shelf_clip0.recall: Track page, left column. + Keep adds clips; Remove with a clip in hand deletes it and its copies (asks twice).
tips: Keeping again after changing the beat makes a new clip: Beat 2.
shelf_clip0.ask: What is a clip, and how is it different from the beat?

track_keep.title: + KEEP
track_keep.summary: Copies the live beat, chords and loop onto the shelf.
track_keep.does: Copies what exists now (the beat, the backing chords and the loop) onto the shelf as clips: Beat 1, Chords 1, Loop 1. Anything already kept is skipped. The last one added goes in your hand. Originals are untouched.

use.text: Tap + Keep after making something.
K.

track_keep.recall: Track page, bottom of the shelf. K on this page. Up to 40 clips; Remove deletes one.
tips: Nothing to keep? Make a beat, tap chords or record a loop first.
track_keep.ask: Why does + Keep say there is nothing to keep?

track_shelf_page.title: SHELF PAGE
track_shelf_page.summary: Shows the next five clips on the shelf.
track_shelf_page.does: Appears when you have more than five clips. Shows the page and total like 1/2; each tap goes on and wraps round to the first page.

use.text: Tap to step through shelf pages.

track_shelf_page.recall: Track page, beside + Keep, once there are over five clips.
tips: Clips are numbered 1 to 5 on every page; keys 1 to 5 pick from the shown page.

track_ruler.title: BAR RULER / PLAY LINE
track_ruler.summary: The numbered bars above the lanes. Tap to set the play line.
track_ruler.does: Tap or drag on a bar number to put the play line there. If the track is playing it jumps to that bar. The bar numbers inverted show the cycle range. Place, Split and Play start from the line.

use.text: Tap or drag along the numbers.
Shift+Left / Right, or , and ., move the line a bar.

track_ruler.recall: Track page, strip above the lanes. Enter sends the line back to bar 1.
tips: Eight bars show at once; Shown - / + scrolls by four.
track_ruler.ask: How do I start playing from a later bar?

track_lanes.title: LANES
track_lanes.summary: Four lanes of bars: Beat, Chords, Loop A, Loop B.
track_lanes.does: Beats go on Beat, chord clips on Chords, loops on Loop A or B (so two loops can play at once). Tap a clip to choose it (double frame); drag it to move it, even between loop lanes. With a clip in hand, tap an empty bar to place it.

use.text: Tap to choose or place; drag a chosen clip to move it.
Arrows choose; Alt+arrows move a bar or lane; Ctrl+V pastes.

track_lanes.recall: Track page, the grid in the middle. Clips snap to whole bars. Ctrl+Z undoes a move.
tips: A clip will not go where bars are taken or the lane is the wrong kind.
track_lanes.ask: Why will my clip not go where I drop it?

mixer_lane0.title: LANE HEADER
mixer_lane0.summary: Chooses a lane in the mixer.
mixer_lane0.does: Each strip is one lane: Beat, Chords, Loop A, Loop B. Tap a strip's name to choose it (inverted). The chosen lane takes the keys. A lane muted or switched off by solo is drawn faint.

use.text: Tap a lane's name.
Left / Right, or 1 to 4.

mixer_lane0.recall: Track page, Mix button (or X). Esc, Enter or X closes the mixer.
mixer_lane0.ask: How do I pick the lane to adjust?

mixer_fader0.title: FADER
mixer_fader0.summary: A lane's level, with a live meter beside it.
mixer_fader0.does: Level from 0 (silent) to 100. 80 plays the lane as recorded; 100 is about 4 dB louder. The small notch marks 80 and dragging near it snaps there. The meter beside it shows loudness while the track plays.

use.text: Tap or drag up and down the fader.
Up / Down move five at a time; 0 resets to 80.

mixer_fader0.recall: Mix panel. Reset puts every lane back to 80. A whole drag is one Ctrl+Z step.
tips: Mix levels are heard in an export.
mixer_fader0.ask: What does the number on the fader mean?

mixer_mute0.title: M (MUTE)
mixer_mute0.does: The lane goes quiet and its name on the lanes above says muted. Its clips go faint. Mute wins over solo: a muted lane stays silent even if soloed.

use.text: Tap M on the lane's strip.
M mutes the chosen lane.

mixer_mute0.recall: Mix panel, under each fader. Tap again to unmute. Reset clears all.
mixer_mute0.ask: How do I silence a whole lane?

mixer_solo0.title: S (SOLO)
mixer_solo0.does: Only lanes with S lit are heard; the others read off. Solo two lanes to hear just those two. Tap again to release.

use.text: Tap S on the lane's strip.
S solos the chosen lane.

mixer_solo0.recall: Mix panel, beside M. Reset clears all solos.
mixer_solo0.ask: How do I hear only the drums?

mixer_play.title: PLAY (MIXER)
mixer_play.summary: Starts and stops the track from the mixer.
mixer_play.does: Works as Play on the tools: plays from the play line (or the cycle). Meters move while it plays, so set levels while you listen.

use.text: Tap Play or Stop.
Space.

mixer_play.recall: Mix panel, right column, top. Ctrl+Space plays from any page.
mixer_play.ask: Can I play the track while I mix?

mixer_reset.title: RESET
mixer_reset.summary: Puts every lane back to 80, unmuted and unsoloed.
mixer_reset.does: Clears the whole mix in one tap. It is one step of Undo.

use.text: Tap Reset.

mixer_reset.recall: Mix panel, right column. Ctrl+Z restores the mix you had.
mixer_reset.ask: How do I clear all my mixer changes?

mixer_done.title: DONE
mixer_done.does: Returns to the track tools. The mix stays with the track and is saved with it.

use.text: Tap Done.
Esc, Enter or X.

mixer_done.ask: How do I close the mixer?

track-mixer.recall: Track page: Mix button (or X). Done or Esc comes back.

synth.title: Synth
synth.intro: The instrument: scope, three strings, chord pads and the loop pedal. This is the page the app opens on.

hdr_sound.title: SOUND NAME
hdr_sound.summary: The current sound, its slot number and how many voices play.
hdr_sound.does: Name, slot (Sound 1-10, or Unsaved after New, Mutate or Undo) and voice count. Tags: REC while recording, Limit when the output is held back, No audio device.

use.text: Tap the header to open the Sound page.
Press 1-9 or 0 to jump to sound 1-10.

hdr_sound.recall: Synth page, top left. Ctrl+Z undoes a sound change. Limit: lower Master volume.
tips: A name ending in * is a mutated copy of another sound.
hdr_sound.ask: What do the Limit and No audio device tags mean?

hdr_tune.title: KEY / SCALE / TEMPO
hdr_tune.summary: Root note, scale, tempo with a beat lamp, and octave.
hdr_tune.does: Left to right: the key's root note, the scale name (min pent = minor pentatonic), tempo in beats per minute with a lamp that flashes on each beat while something plays, and the octave shift.

use.text: Tap the header to open the Tune page, where all of it can be changed.
Ctrl+K key up, Ctrl+S next scale, Ctrl+T tap tempo, Up/Down octave.

hdr_tune.recall: Synth page, top right. Full controls: Tune tab. Key and scale also change with Ctrl+K and Ctrl+S.
tips: Add Shift to Ctrl+K or Ctrl+S to step the other way.
hdr_tune.ask: How do the key and scale change what I can play?

xy.title: SCOPE / TOUCH PAD
xy.summary: Drag to change the sound while you play: two controls at once.
xy.does: The scope draws the real output. Drag on it: left-right and bottom-top each move a control, set by the mapping button (Filter: cutoff, resonance). Let go and it returns, unless Hold is on.

use.text: Drag anywhere on the scope.
Ctrl+G cycles the mapping.

xy.recall: Synth page, the big box. Mapping: corner button or System page.
tips: Moves are recorded into a loop.
xy.ask: What does dragging on the scope actually change?

xymap.title: MAPPING BUTTON
xymap.summary: Picks which two controls the scope pad moves.
xymap.does: Cycles Filter, Wobble, Morph, Space, Bend, Glitch. Each sets what left-right (X) and bottom-top (Y) do; the faint Y and X labels on the scope name them. The name on the button is the active one.

use.text: Tap to step to the next mapping; it wraps around.
Ctrl+G does the same from any page.

xymap.recall: Scope corner on the Synth page; also System page, Touch pad mapping (pick one directly). Ctrl+G steps on.
tips: System page lists all six with their X/Y pair in one row.
xymap.ask: What does each touch pad mapping do?

xyhold.title: HOLD
xyhold.summary: Keeps the pad's last position after you lift your finger.
xyhold.does: Off: the sound goes back to normal when you let go. On: the last X-Y position stays applied (a filter held half shut, glitch left on) until you turn Hold off or move the pad again.

use.text: Tap to switch on or off; lit means on.

xyhold.recall: Synth page scope corner, and System page next to the mappings. Tap again to release.
tips: With Glitch mapped, Hold leaves the crush on until you release it.
xyhold.ask: When should I use Hold on the touch pad?

scopeview.title: 3D
scopeview.summary: Switches the scope between the 3D stack and the moving line.
scopeview.does: Lit: the newest real cycle of your sound sits at the front and older ones move back and fade, so changes roll through the stack. Off: the classic moving line. Chords and noise show the last 20 ms.

use.text: Tap to switch; lit means 3D.
Ctrl+V switches. Hold Ctrl+C to open the filter, Ctrl+X to close it.

scopeview.recall: Synth page, top right of the scope, left of the mapping key.
tips: Hold a note with Space, then hold Ctrl+C and watch the cycles sharpen.
scopeview.ask: Why does the scope show waves stacked in 3D?

string2.title: HIGH STRING (S3)
string2.summary: Top string: Q to P. Ten notes, left to right goes up the scale.
string2.does: One monophonic string: it sounds one note at a time. Press a note box to play, or a key. Hold one and press another on the string and the note slides without restarting; release the newer key and it slides back.

use.text: Press to play; drag to slide.
Q to P. Shift for semitones.

string2.recall: Synth page, top string. On the Q20 these are the top letter row. Backspace stops stuck notes.
tips: Bright frames mark the root; brackets show the real pitch.
string2.ask: How do slides work on the strings?

string1.title: MIDDLE STRING (S2)
string1.summary: Middle string: A to L. Nine notes in the scale.
string1.does: The middle of three strings. Strings are tuned a set gap apart (5 semitones by default, Tune page). Same rules as the others: one note at a time, a second key on the row slides it.

use.text: Press to play; drag to slide.
A to L. Hold one, tap another to slide.

string1.recall: Synth page, middle string. Change spacing in Tune, String gap.
tips: Hold a note on each row to glide a chord.
string1.ask: How are the three strings tuned against each other?

string0.title: LOW STRING (S1)
string0.summary: Bottom string: Z to M. Seven notes, the lowest range.
string0.does: The lowest string. It starts one key in on screen to line up with the Q20 keyboard. With the chord row on (the $ key) or Alt held, these keys play backing chords instead of notes.

use.text: Press a note box; drag to slide.
Z X C V B N M. Alt + a key plays chord I-VII; $ toggles chord row.

string0.recall: Synth page, bottom string. Chord row on: label tags show on these keys; $ switches it off.
tips: On the Beat page this row still plays notes.
string0.ask: How do I make the bottom row play chords?

chord0.title: CHORD PADS I-VII
chord0.summary: The seven chords of your key; what a tap does depends on mode.
chord0.does: Each pad shows a chord and its numeral (small = minor). Prog: a tap adds it to a looping progression of up to eight. Hold: latches one chord. Drone: toggles its root as a held note.

use.text: Tap a pad. Mode: the button beside the pads.
Alt+Z..M: chords I to VII.

chord0.recall: Synth and Backing pages. Ctrl+X clears; Ctrl+Backspace removes the last chord.
tips: Chords follow the key and scale.
chord0.ask: What do the chord pads do in each mode?

pslot0.title: PROGRESSION SLOTS
pslot0.summary: The chords you queued, up to eight. Tap to select one.
pslot0.does: Each filled slot shows a chord name; the playing one is inverted. Tap a slot to select it (double frame), then tap a chord pad to replace it. Tap the selected slot again to deselect.

use.text: Tap a filled slot, then a chord pad to swap it.

pslot0.recall: Synth page, strip above the chord pads; also Backing page. Ctrl+Backspace removes the last chord.
tips: Empty slots show only their number and cannot be tapped.
pslot0.ask: How do I change one chord in my progression?

backmode.title: CHORD MODE
backmode.summary: Prog, Hold or Drone: what a chord tap does.
backmode.does: Prog adds taps to a looping progression. Hold plays one chord until you pick another (tap it again to stop). Drone switches a held bass note for each chord you tap on and off.

use.text: Tap to step Prog, Hold, Drone.
Ctrl+B steps the mode.

backmode.recall: Synth page, beside the pads; three buttons on the Backing page. Ctrl+B steps it.
tips: Mode names appear as a toast when you use Ctrl+B.
backmode.ask: What is the difference between Prog, Hold and Drone?

backplay.title: BACKING PLAY / STOP
backplay.summary: Starts and stops the backing chords.
backplay.does: Plays the progression (or held chord or drones) in time with the tempo, on the chord length set in Backing. Tapping a chord in Prog mode already starts it, so Play then stops it.

use.text: Tap to start or stop; inverted while playing.
Ctrl+P toggles it from any page.

backplay.recall: Synth page and Backing page, beside the chord pads. Ctrl+P. Ignored while the Track plays.
tips: Backing joins the bar in progress if a beat or loop is already running.
backplay.ask: Why does the backing start when I tap a chord?

loop_pedal.title: LOOP PEDAL
loop_pedal.summary: One button to record, play and layer a loop.
loop_pedal.does: Tap: count-in, then it records your playing (notes, slides, bends, pad moves). Tap again to close the loop at the end of the bar. Next taps overdub a layer, then finish it. The label shows what the next tap does.

use.text: Tap Loop; the label shows the next step.
Enter = tap. Ctrl+L stop/start, Ctrl+D clear.

loop_pedal.recall: Synth page, bottom left. Undo removes the last layer; Ctrl+D erases the loop. Volume: System page.
tips: Up to 64 bars and six layers, each with its own sound.
loop_pedal.ask: How do I record and layer a loop?

loop_undo.title: LOOP UNDO
loop_undo.does: Takes off the newest overdub layer, one tap per layer, back to the first take. Only affects the loop, not your sound or the track.

use.text: Tap Undo to peel off one layer.
Ctrl+U.

loop_undo.recall: Synth page, bottom row, second button. Ctrl+U. Ctrl+D erases the whole loop.
loop_undo.ask: How do I undo a loop layer?

loop_playstop.title: LOOP PLAY / STOP
loop_playstop.summary: Starts or stops the loop without erasing it.
loop_playstop.does: Shows a stop square while the loop plays and a play triangle otherwise. Stopping keeps every layer; start plays it again from the top, in time with the tempo.

use.text: Tap to stop or restart.
Ctrl+L.

loop_playstop.recall: Synth page, bottom row, third button. Ctrl+L. Ctrl+D erases the loop for good.
loop_playstop.ask: How do I stop the loop and start it again?

sustain.title: SUSTAIN
sustain.summary: Keeps notes ringing after you let go.
sustain.does: While on, released notes keep sounding, and a new key on a ringing string slides that note instead of starting a new one. Tap to latch on; tap again to release. Holding Space does the same while held.

use.text: Tap to latch on or off; inverted means on.
Hold Space. Backspace (panic) turns the latch off.

sustain.recall: Synth page, bottom row. Space while held. Backspace silences everything and clears the latch.
tips: Sustain plus slides makes a good slow glissando.
sustain.ask: What does sustain do when I play slides?

octave_down.title: OCTAVE - / +
octave_down.summary: Shifts the whole instrument one octave down or up.
octave_down.does: Moves every string by 12 semitones, up to three octaves each way. Held notes sweep to the new octave without restarting. The octave number shows top right in the header.

use.text: Tap - for lower, + for higher.
Down / Up arrows, or - and =.

octave_down.recall: Synth page bottom row; also Tune page, Octave. Arrows are on the Q20's symbol layer.
tips: Octave range is -3 to +3.
octave_down.ask: How far can I shift the octave?

new_sound.title: NEW SOUND
new_sound.does: Builds a complete new playable sound, loudness-matched so it is not louder than the others. The old sound goes on the undo stack. It is Unsaved until you Store or Save it.

use.text: Tap New.
Ctrl+R. Ctrl+Z goes back; Ctrl+N nudges instead.

new_sound.recall: Synth page, bottom row; Sound page, New sound. Ctrl+Z undoes it (24 steps). Ctrl+F keeps it.
tips: Like one? Press Ctrl+F before you roll again.
new_sound.ask: How do I keep a random sound I like?

menu.title: MENU
menu.summary: Opens the Sound page and the tab strip to other pages.
menu.does: The Synth page has no tab strip, so Menu takes you to the Sound page, which shows the tabs for Track, Synth, Sound, Beat, Backing, Tune, System, Help and Chat.

use.text: Tap Menu, then choose a tab.
Tab steps to the next page; Esc comes back here.

menu.recall: Synth page, bottom right. Esc from any page returns to Synth.
menu.ask: How do I get to the other pages from here?

key_readout.title: KEY READOUT
key_readout.summary: The root note and scale every string is locked to.
key_readout.does: Shows the key (A, C#...) and the scale in short form, like min pent. Every string plays only notes of this scale, so nothing sounds wrong.

use.text: Tap it to open the Tune page and change key or scale.
Ctrl+K raises the key a semitone; Ctrl+S picks the next scale.

key_readout.recall: Top of the Synth page, left of the tempo. Same controls: Tune page.
tips: Shift with Ctrl+K lowers the key.
key_readout.ask: How does the scale lock work?

tempo_readout.title: TEMPO READOUT
tempo_readout.summary: The speed of the beat, backing and loop, in beats per minute.
tempo_readout.does: Shows the tempo. The small square beside it blinks on the beat while anything is running. One tempo drives the beat, the backing, the loop pedal and the track.

use.text: Tap it to open the Tune page, where tempo has - and + and Tap.
Ctrl+T taps the tempo with the beat of your finger.

tempo_readout.recall: Top of the Synth page, between key and octave. Also Tune, Backing and Beat.
tips: Two taps already set it; more taps average out (within 2 seconds).
tempo_readout.ask: How do I change the tempo?

octave_readout.title: OCTAVE READOUT
octave_readout.summary: How many octaves the whole instrument is shifted.
octave_readout.does: Shows 0 at rest, or +1, -2... up to three octaves each way. It moves every string together, so a part can sit higher or lower without changing keys.

use.text: Tap it to open the Tune page. The - and + buttons are at the bottom of Synth.
Down and Up arrows, or - and =.

octave_readout.recall: Top right of the Synth page. Buttons: bottom row of Synth, and the Tune page.
tips: Held notes sweep to the new octave without restarting.
octave_readout.ask: How far can I shift the octave?

synth.recall: The app opens here. From any other page press Esc, or tap the Synth tab.

sound.title: Sound
sound.intro: Pick a sound, make a new one and shape it. Ten slots, five quick-change sliders on one page, favourites below, and all parameters on request.

tab_track.title: PAGE TABS
tab_track.summary: The strip of nine tabs along the top.
tab_track.does: Track, Synth, Sound, Beat, Backing, Tune, System, Help and Chat. The page you are on is inverted. Chat shows how many copilot messages are unread. The Synth page has no strip: Menu or any tab brings you here.

use.text: Tap a tab to go there.
Tab steps to the next page; Esc goes to Synth.

tab_track.recall: Top of every page except Synth. Tab cycles forward through all nine; Esc returns to Synth.
tips: Ctrl+H toggles Help and Ctrl+Y toggles Chat from anywhere.

param16.title: CUTOFF
param16.summary: How bright or dark the sound is.
param16.does: The filter's cutoff frequency, 40 Hz to 16 kHz. Low cutoff is dark and muffled; high is bright and open. The X axis of the Filter touch pad mapping moves it live.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param17.title: RESO
param17.does: Resonance boosts a narrow band around the cutoff. Low is smooth; high makes the filter whistle and ring, especially when moving the cutoff. Up to 95%.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param17.recall: Sound page, quick sliders (also All parameters p.2/4). Re-tap the sound's slot to reload it.
tips: Very high RESO plus low CUTOFF can be piercing.
param17.ask: What does RESO do to the sound?

param11.title: ATTACK
param11.summary: How fast a note fades in.
param11.does: Attack is the time from pressing a key to full volume, 1 ms to 4 s. Short is a clear click or pluck; long is a slow swell like a pad. The scale is logarithmic.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param11.recall: Sound page, quick sliders (also All parameters p.1/4). Re-tap the sound's slot to reload it.

param11.ask: What does ATTACK do to the sound?

param14.title: RELEASE
param14.summary: How long a note fades after you let go.
param14.does: Release is the fade-out time, 10 ms to 8 s. Short stops the sound at once; long lets notes ring on and blur together.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param14.recall: Sound page, quick sliders (also All parameters p.2/4). Re-tap the sound's slot to reload it.
tips: Dream sounds use long releases; shorten them for tight playing.
param14.ask: What does RELEASE do to the sound?

param31.title: GLIDE
param31.does: Portamento: how long the pitch takes to travel when you slide from one note to another, 0 to 2000 ms. Short is a quick snap; long is a slow, swooping slide. Tune's Glide speed scales every sound.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param31.recall: Sound page, quick sliders (also All parameters p.3/4). Re-tap the sound's slot to reload it.
tips: 0 gives instant jumps without a slide.
param31.ask: What does GLIDE do to the sound?

param32.title: DRIVE
param32.does: Saturation squashes the wave: 0 is clean, low is warm, high is gritty and fuzzy. The Morph touch pad mapping adds drive live.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param32.recall: Sound page, quick sliders (also All parameters p.3/4). Re-tap the sound's slot to reload it.
tips: Drive adds loudness; watch the Limit tag.
param32.ask: What does DRIVE do to the sound?

param34.title: DELAY
param34.does: Delay repeats the sound after a pause, 0 to 70%. Echo spacing follows the tempo: set it with DLY TIME. The X axis of the Space touch pad mapping adds delay live.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param34.recall: Sound page, quick sliders (also All parameters p.3/4). Re-tap the sound's slot to reload it.
tips: Slow, sparse playing sounds best with echoes.
param34.ask: What does DELAY do to the sound?

param37.title: REVERB
param37.does: Reverb adds the sense of a space, 0 to 80%. Low is a small room; high washes the sound out. The Y axis of the Space touch pad mapping adds reverb live.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param37.recall: Sound page, quick sliders (also All parameters p.4/4). Re-tap the sound's slot to reload it.

param37.ask: What does REVERB do to the sound?

param0.title: WAVE A
param0.does: The oscillator is the tone source. Sine is pure and soft, triangle is mellow, saw is bright and buzzy, square is hollow and reedy. The slider steps through the four shapes.

use.text: Drag along the bar: it clicks through its steps; the name shows at the right.

param0.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 1/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Saw or square into a low cutoff is the classic synth lead.
param0.ask: What does WAVE A do to the sound?

param1.title: WAVE B
param1.does: Oscillator B has its own shape (sine, triangle, saw, square). You hear it when B MIX is above zero; it also drives the FM effect, even at zero mix.

use.text: Drag along the bar: it clicks through its steps; the name shows at the right.

param1.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 1/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Set B PITCH to +12 for an octave of shimmer.
param1.ask: What does WAVE B do to the sound?

param2.title: B MIX
param2.summary: Blend between oscillator A and B.
param2.does: 0% is only A, 100% only B, in between is both together. The Morph touch pad mapping moves this live.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param2.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 1/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Small B MIX plus a little DETUNE gives a fat, slowly beating tone.
param2.ask: What does B MIX do to the sound?

param3.title: B PITCH
param3.does: Shifts B from -12 to +24 semitones against A. +12 is an octave up, +7 a fifth up, -12 an octave down. Whole steps only.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param3.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 1/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Fifths and octaves sound sweet; odd values sound dissonant.
param3.ask: What does B PITCH do to the sound?

param4.title: DETUNE
param4.summary: Nudges oscillator B slightly out of tune.
param4.does: Raises B by up to 50 cents (100 cents is one semitone). A tiny detune makes A and B beat against each other, which sounds thicker and alive. It only changes B.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param4.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 1/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Around 5 to 12 cents is the thick-but-in-tune range.
param4.ask: What does DETUNE do to the sound?

param5.title: UNISON
param5.summary: Adds a second copy of oscillator A.
param5.does: Blends in a duplicate of A tuned slightly off by SPREAD. At 0 you hear one voice; higher gives a wider, fatter, chorus-like sound.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param5.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 1/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Needs SPREAD above 0 to be audible.
param5.ask: What does UNISON do to the sound?

param6.title: SPREAD
param6.summary: How far the UNISON copy is detuned.
param6.does: Sets the detune of the unison copy, 0 to 40 cents. More spread is wider and more swirly. You hear nothing from it while UNISON is at 0.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param6.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 1/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Pair high UNISON with 10 to 20 cents.
param6.ask: What does SPREAD do to the sound?

param7.title: SUB
param7.summary: A sine one octave below the note.
param7.does: Mixes in a pure low sine an octave under what you play. Adds weight and body, especially on bass sounds. 0 is off.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param7.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 1/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Small speakers may not reproduce very low notes.
param7.ask: What does SUB do to the sound?

param8.title: NOISE
param8.does: Adds random noise, 0 to 60%. A little gives a breathy or plucked edge; a lot turns the sound into a wind or snare-like rush. Shaped by the filter.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param8.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 1/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Short decay plus noise makes percussion.
param8.ask: What does NOISE do to the sound?

param9.title: WIDTH
param9.summary: Pulse width of the square wave.
param9.does: Changes how wide the high part of a SQUARE wave is, 10 to 90%. 50% is a hollow clarinet tone; low or high is thin and nasal. It has no effect on other wave shapes.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param9.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 1/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: LFO>WID can sweep this for a shimmering tone.
param9.ask: What does WIDTH do to the sound?

param10.title: FM
param10.does: Frequency modulation: B wobbles A's pitch very fast, adding bell-like and metallic overtones. 0 is off, 6 is harsh and clangorous. B PITCH changes the character; B MIX does not matter.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param10.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 1/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Try FM 1 to 2 with B PITCH +12 for glassy bells.
param10.ask: What does FM do to the sound?

param11.summary: How fast a note fades in.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param11.recall: Sound page, quick sliders (also All parameters p.1/4). Re-tap the sound's slot to reload it.

param11.ask: What does ATTACK do to the sound?

param12.title: DECAY
param12.summary: How fast a note falls to its sustain level.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param12.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 2/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Decay does nothing if SUSTAIN is 100%.
param12.ask: What does DECAY do to the sound?

param13.title: SUSTAIN
param13.summary: The volume held while a key stays down.
param13.does: 0 to 100% of the peak. At 0 the note dies away on its own like a plucked string; at 100% it stays full until you let go.

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.

param13.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 2/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: Use DECAY with low SUSTAIN for a pluck.
param13.ask: What does SUSTAIN do to the sound?

param14.title: RELEASE

param15.title: FILTER
param15.summary: Type of filter: low, high or band.
param15.does: A filter removes part of the sound. LOW passes bass and cuts treble (darker). HIGH cuts bass (thinner). BAND keeps a slice in the middle (nasal, radio-like). The slider steps through them.

use.text: Drag along the bar: it clicks through its steps; the name shows at the right.

param15.recall: Sound > All parameters, page 2/4. Re-tap the sound's slot to reload the saved version.
tips: LOW is the usual choice.
param15.ask: What does FILTER do to the sound?

use.text: Tap or drag along the bar; the value shows at the right.
